title: Steampunk Fish in Glass Dome
description: A detailed mechanical steampunk fish with brass gears and glowing orange eye floats inside a large glass dome. It holds a thorny stem with two red roses while surrounded by air bubbles, seaweed, and small floating clock faces against a dramatic sunset backdrop with palm trees.
prompt: A highly detailed steampunk fish made of brass and copper with visible gears and a glowing orange eye, swimming inside a large antique glass dome. The fish holds two red roses on a thorny stem with its mechanical fin. Inside the dome are air bubbles, seaweed, and tiny floating clock faces. The dome sits on an old wooden desk with scrolls, gems, scales, and scattered rose petals. Dramatic sunset sky with palm trees and a pink beam of light in the background.
